title: Understanding Bonds and Debt Instruments
content: A bond is a fixed-income instrument that represents a loan made by an investor to a borrower (typically corporate or governmental). The issuer promises to pay a specified interest rate (coupon rate) periodically and return the principal amount on maturity date. Bonds include Government Securities (G-Secs), Municipal Bonds, and Corporate Bonds/Debentures. Bonds provide regular income and lower volatility than equities.
